title: Those Rebels Won’t Escape Us
caption: Those Rebels Won’t Escape Us (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to ▲ _Stinger_ or _Virago_. OR Cancel Darklighter Spin. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at same system or sector as _Stinger_ or _Virago_, opponent may not target those starfighters with weapons for remainder of turn.
lore: “I don’t know how we’re gonna get out of this one.”

notes: Not unique (no dot on slip or printed card; base 'Unrestricted'). Curly apostrophe in Won’t in the slip's heading and caption (wiki page title straight). Printed base is a Used or Lost Interrupt; slip banner reads USED INTERRUPT. The slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; Stinger and Virago italic on the slip (both occurrences) → _…_ (stub plain). 'OR Cancel' / 'OR If' capitalised as printed. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes (wiki straight single quotes) and curly apostrophes in don’t / we’re. Base scan 350 px only; copyright line legible: 1997 (Dagobah). Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4 -pre, 350 px; non-pre also exists, not downloaded).
